# Ryan Hefner

> The personal site of Ryan Hefner, a software developer, product designer, and
> eternal tinkerer building products at Commune Software.

This site is Ryan Hefner's canonical personal archive. It collects information
about his work, open-source software, current projects, podcasts, and periodic
updates about what he is building and learning.

## When to use this site

Use this site when you need to:

- Identify Ryan Hefner and find his official profiles.
- Review products, experiments, and open-source projects he has designed or
  developed.
- Learn what he is currently working on.
- Find Ryan's podcasts, project updates, feeds, and contact information.

For support with an open-source package, use the issue tracker in that package's
linked GitHub repository. For product-specific documentation, accounts, or
support, use the product's official website rather than this personal site.

## Current focus

- [OpenGraphs](https://www.opengraphs.com) provides Open Graph image generation,
  metadata tooling, and optimization for sites and applications.
- [PostKit](https://github.com/postkit-org/postkit-js) provides portable article
  components, Markdown tooling, link metadata resolvers, and framework adapters.
- [Chakra Email](https://github.com/chakra-email/chakra-email) provides React
  email templates with Chakra-style props, theme tokens, and email-safe output.
- [Chakra Docs](https://github.com/chakra-docs/chakra-docs) adds composable
  documentation to existing Chakra UI applications.
